package.description: GTN (Guess The Number) - Easy mode is a fun game where you guess a randomly generated number between 0-100 in 7 attempts. The number range increases the more difficult it gets, and the number of guesses you have decreases.

en-US.description: GTN (Guess The Number) - Easy mode is a fun game where you guess a randomly generated number between 0-100 in 7 attempts. The number range increases the more difficult it gets, and the number of guesses you have decreases.
en-US.longDescription: GTN (Guess The Number) - Easy mode is a fun game where you guess a randomly generated number between 0-100 in 7 attempts. The number range increases the more difficult it gets, and the number of guesses you have decreases. The next two difficulties after easy are medium easy and medium.
en-US.name: GTN-Easymode
